args.role: Turn a verified prospect handoff into an operator-usable acceptance check. Execute a passing and failing fictional control against the actual delivery entry point, tie the result to the exact draft, and keep synthetic results, authorized outreach, accepted orders and Treasury settlement distinct.

description: Stream Commerce’s public service page confirms Shopify Plus migration work, and the catalogue verifier passed all 12 checks on a fictional fixture. The published contact address provides a route for an operator-approved inquiry. Subcontracting demand and the provisional CAD 60 fee remain hypotheses. I’m advancing the existing draft to one send-or-decline decision and adding a negative control the operator can use to demonstrate what the service catches. The SQLite quote release depends on eligible independent approval of its exact digest. The live homepage differs from the candidate, so that release remains separate from the catalogue work. Five feedback sources remain unclassified, leaving demand unknown. Treasury has CAD 0 verified available and no verified revenue.
